user.title: Sign in to State Grid
user.description: Enter the Online State Grid username and password. Password login is used by default; an SMS is sent only when the server requires new-device verification.

device_verification.title: New-device verification
device_verification.description: The server requires new-device verification. A code was sent to the phone ending in {phone_suffix}.

reauth_confirm.title: Complete security verification
reauth_confirm.description: Automatic password login needs additional authentication. Continue to retry; an SMS is sent only when requested by the server.

reauth_credentials.title: Update password
reauth_credentials.description: The saved password is no longer accepted. Enter the current Online State Grid password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the State Grid gateway ({error_code}): {error_message}
error.cannot_send_verification_code: Unable to send the new-device verification code ({error_code}): {error_message}
error.interactive_challenge_unsupported: The server requires an unsupported interactive challenge ({error_code}): {error_message}

abort.already_configured: This State Grid account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: The signed-in account does not match this entry
